bounded_candidate.reason: The existing platform-projects Flux Kustomization owns these project overlays. A nonrecursive build can avoid unrelated controller, CRD, storage, policy and monitoring builds while retaining the projects parent transformations.
limitations: There is no independent llunde Flux Kustomization, so this candidate still renders all four projects.
A leaf-only Kustomize build is not equivalent to the parent Flux transformations without additional proof.
Parser migration/application are separate Flux Kustomizations and must fall back until their full dependency closure is modeled.
No wall-time improvement is claimed without measurement.
eligibility: A present, valid last-applied baseline and a normal incremental reconciliation.
An exact recognized image-digest update and matching deployment receipt in an explicitly mapped existing project.
Semantic comparison proves no changes to resources, components, generators, patches, substitutions, namespace, policy, secrets, image names or other Kustomization fields.
Every changed path is accounted for; unknown paths and unproven dependencies fail closed to the existing full build.
full_build_fallback: Full, scheduled, recovery or interrupted reconciliation requiring all systems.
Missing baseline, unknown project, unmapped Flux dependency or ambiguous diff.
Shared settings, parent/root Kustomizations, charts, keys, secrets, policy, toolchain or reconciler changes.
Migration-coupled projects or any non-image-pin manifest change until dependency-aware targeting is qualified.
preserved_authority: Exact image digest, source, repository, signer and workflow provenance validation remains in internal/ci/deploy.go.
Deployment ordering, anti-rollback receipts and approved changed-file boundaries remain unchanged.
Protected-main revision and clean-checkout guards, state lock and production-branch publication remain in internal/reconcile/commands.go and run.go.
Keep live Flux substitutions and source mapping; do not use --dry-run because installed Flux help explicitly says it skips Secret/ConfigMap substitutions.
Keep existing post-publication Kubernetes readiness, expected source revision and served frontend revision checks.

missing_qualification: Direct Commands.Plan assertions for recognized pin targeting versus every fallback condition.
